description: This file defines a LinkedList class implemented in Kotlin, providing linked list operations such as add, remove, size, and get, along with an internal Node class.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation providing add, remove, size, and get functionalities.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helps to unlink (remove) a node from the list during a removal operation.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: A companion object method to find the last node starting from head.
